feed.title: Kauê de Moraes Vestena
feed.subtitle: Kauê de Moraes Vestena is a PhD candidate in Geodetic Sciences at the Federal University of Paraná, specializing in accessibility mapping using OpenStreetMap and open-source geospatial technologies. Creator of OSM SidewalKreator QGIS plugin and researcher focused on inclusive urban planning, collaborative cartography, and sustainable approaches to pedestrian network mapping. Discover research publications, open-source projects, and contributions to accessible city design.
